parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the flush button of the toilet, typically made of durable plastic and located on the top or side of the tank.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism, releasing water from the tank into the bowl to clean it.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically or pivots slightly when pressed to trigger the flush valve.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of the toilet tank, made of plastic or ceramic, covering the water tank.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the internal flushing components and prevents debris from entering the tank.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or removed for maintenance or cleaning purposes.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the toilet, made of glazed ceramic, forming the bowl and base structure.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user, holds water, and channels waste into the drainage system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part anchored to the floor.
